Require Import Language.

Inductive erased_sort : sort -> Prop :=
| erased_Tm : forall a, erased_tm a -> erased_sort (Tm a)
| erased_Co : forall a b A, erased_tm a -> erased_tm b -> erased_tm A -> erased_sort (Co (Eq a b A)).

Definition erased_context : context -> Prop :=
  Forall (fun p => match p with (a,s) => erased_sort s end).

Definition Good (G : context) (D : available_props):=
  erased_context G /\
  forall c1 A B1 T1,
    binds c1 (Co (Eq A B1 T1)) G
    -> c1 `in` D
    -> exists C, Par G D A C /\ Par G D B1 C.

Definition AnnGood G D := Good (erase_context G) D.

Definition irrelevant G D (a : tm) :=
  (forall x A, binds x (Tm A) G -> x `notin` fv_tm_tm_tm (erase_tm a)) /\ AnnGood G D.

Theorem preservation : forall G a A, AnnTyping G a A -> forall a', head_reduction G a a' -> AnnTyping G a' A.

Theorem progress : forall G a A, irrelevant G (dom G) a -> AnnTyping G a A -> CoercedValue a \/ exists a', head_reduction G a a'.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.
(** syntax *)

Definition covar := var. (*r coercion variables *)
Definition datacon := atom.
Definition const := atom.
Definition tyfam := atom.
Inductive relflag : Set :=  (*r relevance flag *)
 | Rel : relflag
 | Irrel : relflag.

Inductive tm : Set :=  (*r types and kinds *)
 | a_Star : tm
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Abs (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_UAbs (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm)
 | a_Fam (F:tyfam)
 | a_Const (T:const)
 | a_Pi (rho:relflag) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Conv (a:tm) (g:co)
 | a_CPi (phi:constraint) (B:tm)
 | a_CAbs (phi:constraint) (b:tm)
 | a_UCAbs (b:tm)
 | a_CApp (a:tm) (g:co)
 | a_Bullet : tm
 | a_DataCon (K:datacon)
 | a_Case (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
with brs : Set :=  (*r case branches *)
 | br_None : brs
 | br_One (K:datacon) (a:tm) (brs5:brs)
with co : Set :=  (*r explicit coercions *)
 | g_Triv : co
 | g_Var_b (_:nat)
 | g_Var_f (c:covar)
 | g_Beta (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | g_Refl (a:tm)
 | g_Refl2 (a:tm) (b:tm) (g:co)
 | g_Sym (g:co)
 | g_Trans (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_PiCong (rho:relflag) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AbsCong (rho:relflag) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_AppCong (g1:co) (rho:relflag) (g2:co)
 | g_PiFst (g:co)
 | g_CPiFst (g:co)
 | g_IsoSnd (g:co)
 | g_PiSnd (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiCong (g1:co) (g3:co)
 | g_CAbsCong (g1:co) (g3:co) (g4:co)
 | g_CAppCong (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_CPiSnd (g:co) (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_Cast (g1:co) (g2:co)
 | g_EqCong (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co)
 | g_IsoConv (phi1:constraint) (phi2:constraint) (g:co)
 | g_Eta (a:tm)
 | g_Left (g:co) (g':co)
 | g_Right (g:co) (g':co)
with constraint : Set :=  (*r props *)
 | Eq (a:tm) (b:tm) (A:tm).

Inductive sort : Set :=  (*r binding classifier *)
 | Tm (A:tm)
 | Co (phi:constraint).

Inductive sig_sort : Set :=  (*r signature classifier *)
 | Cs (A:tm)
 | Ax (a:tm) (A:tm).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * sort ).

Definition available_props : Type := atoms.

Definition sig : Set := list (atom * sig_sort).

(* EXPERIMENTAL *)
(** auxiliary functions on the new list types *)
(** library functions *)
(** subrules *)
(** arities *)
(** opening up abstractions *)
Fixpoint open_brs_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (brs_6:brs) {struct brs_6}: brs :=
  match brs_6 with
     (lc_brs brs5) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case a brs5)).

(* defns LC_sort *)
Fixpoint fv_tm_tm_co (g_5:co) : vars :=
  match g_5 with
  | g_Triv => {}
  | (g_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (g_Var_f c) => {}
  | (g_Beta a b) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (g_Refl a) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a)
  | (g_Refl2 a b g) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_Sym g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_Trans g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_PiCong rho g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_AbsCong rho g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_AppCong g1 rho g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_PiFst g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_CPiFst g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_IsoSnd g) => (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_PiSnd g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_CPiCong g1 g3) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g3)
  | (g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g3) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g4)
  | (g_CAppCong g g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_CPiSnd g g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_Cast g1 g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_EqCong g1 A g2) => (fv_tm_tm_co g1) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g2)
  | (g_IsoConv phi1 phi2 g) => (fv_tm_tm_constraint phi1) \u (fv_tm_tm_constraint phi2) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (g_Eta a) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a)
  | (g_Left g g') => (fv_tm_tm_co g) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g')
  | (g_Right g g') => (fv_tm_tm_co g) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g')
end
with fv_tm_tm_brs (brs_6:brs) : vars :=
  match brs_6 with
  | br_None => {}
  | (br_One K a brs5) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_brs brs5)
end
with fv_tm_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_Star => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_Abs rho A b) => (fv_tm_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (a_UAbs rho b) => (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (a_App a rho b) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Fam F) => {}
  | (a_Const T) => {}
  | (a_Pi rho A B) => (fv_tm_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Conv a g) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | (a_CPi phi B) => (fv_tm_tm_constraint phi) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm B)
  | (a_CAbs phi b) => (fv_tm_tm_constraint phi) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (a_UCAbs b) => (fv_tm_tm_tm b)
  | (a_CApp a g) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_co g)
  | a_Bullet => {}
  | (a_DataCon K) => {}
  | (a_Case a brs5) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_brs brs5)
end
with fv_tm_tm_constraint (phi5:constraint) : vars :=
  match phi5 with
  | (Eq a b A) => (fv_tm_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm b) \u (fv_tm_tm_tm A)
end.

Fixpoint erase_tm (a : tm) : tm :=
   match a with
   | a_Star    => a_Star
   | a_Var_b n => a_Var_b n
   | a_Var_f x => a_Var_f x
   | a_Abs rho A b => a_UAbs rho (erase_tm b)
   | a_UAbs rho b => a_UAbs rho (erase_tm b)
   | a_App a Rel b => a_App (erase_tm a) Rel (erase_tm b)
   | a_App a Irrel b => a_App (erase_tm a) Irrel a_Bullet
   | a_Const T => a_Const T
   | a_Fam F => a_Fam F
   | a_Pi rho A B => a_Pi rho (erase_tm A) (erase_tm B)
   | a_Conv a _ => erase_tm a
   | a_CPi phi B => a_CPi (erase_constraint phi) (erase_tm B)
   | a_CAbs phi b => a_UCAbs (erase_tm b)
   | a_UCAbs b => a_UCAbs (erase_tm b)
   | a_CApp a g => a_CApp (erase_tm a) g_Triv
   | a_DataCon K => a_Star  (* a_DataCon K *)
   | a_Case a brs => a_Star (* a_Case (erase_tm a) (erase_brs brs) *)
   | a_Bullet => a_Bullet
   end
with erase_brs (x : brs) : brs :=
   match x with
   | br_None => br_None
   | br_One k a y => br_One k (erase_tm a) (erase_brs y)
   end
with erase_constraint (phi : constraint) : constraint :=
   match phi with
   | Eq A B A1 => Eq (erase_tm A) (erase_tm B) (erase_tm A1)
   end.

Definition erase_sort s :=
 match s with
 | Tm a => Tm (erase_tm a)
 | Co p => Co (erase_constraint p)
end.

Definition erase_csort s :=
 match s with
 | Cs a   => Cs (erase_tm a)
 | Ax a A => Ax (erase_tm a) (erase_tm A)
end.

Definition erase_context G := map erase_sort G.
Definition erase_sig S := map erase_csort S.

(* -------------- A specific signature with Fix ------------ *)
Definition Fix : atom := proj1_sig (atom_fresh empty).

Definition FixDef : tm :=
  (a_Abs Irrel a_Star
         (a_Abs Rel (a_Pi Rel (a_Var_b 0) (a_Var_b 1))
                (a_App (a_Var_b 0) Rel
                       (a_App (a_App (a_Fam Fix) Irrel (a_Var_b 1)) Rel (a_Var_b 0))))).

Definition FixTy : tm :=
  a_Pi Irrel a_Star
       (a_Pi Rel (a_Pi Rel (a_Var_b 0) (a_Var_b 1))
             (a_Var_b 1)).

Definition an_toplevel : sig := Fix ~ Ax FixDef FixTy.

Definition toplevel : sig := erase_sig an_toplevel.

(** definitions *)

(* defns JValue *)
Inductive CoercedValue : tm -> Prop :=    (* defn CoercedValue *)
 | CV : forall (a:tm),
     Value a ->
     CoercedValue a
 | CC : forall (a:tm) (g:co),
     lc_co g ->
     Value a ->
     CoercedValue  ( (a_Conv a g) )
with Value : tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Value *)
 | Value_Star :
     Value a_Star
 | Value_Pi : forall (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     Value (a_Pi rho A B)
 | Value_CPi : forall (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CPi phi B) ->
     Value (a_CPi phi B)
 | Value_AbsRel : forall (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs Rel A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs Rel A a)
 | Value_UAbsRel : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UAbs Rel a) ->
     Value (a_UAbs Rel a)
 | Value_UAbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Value  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value (a_UAbs Irrel a)
 | Value_AbsIrrel : forall (L:vars) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> CoercedValue  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Value (a_Abs Irrel A a)
 | Value_CAbs : forall (phi:constraint) (a:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CAbs phi a) ->
     Value (a_CAbs phi a)
 | Value_UCAbs : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a) ->
     Value (a_UCAbs a)
with value_type : tm -> Prop :=    (* defn value_type *)
 | value_type_Star :
     value_type a_Star
 | value_type_Pi : forall (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     value_type (a_Pi rho A B)
 | value_type_CPi : forall (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CPi phi B) ->
     value_type (a_CPi phi B).

(* defns Jconsistent *)
Inductive erased_tm : tm -> Prop :=    (* defn erased_tm *)
 | erased_a_Bullet :
     erased_tm a_Bullet
 | erased_a_Star :
     erased_tm a_Star
 | erased_a_Var : forall (x:tmvar),
     erased_tm (a_Var_f x)
 | erased_a_Abs : forall (L:vars) (rho:relflag) (a:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> erased_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_UAbs rho a) )
 | erased_a_App : forall (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b:tm),
     erased_tm a ->
     erased_tm b ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_App a rho b) )
 | erased_a_Pi : forall (L:vars) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
     erased_tm A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> erased_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_Pi rho A B) )
 | erased_a_CPi : forall (L:vars) (a b A B:tm),
     erased_tm a ->
     erased_tm b ->
     erased_tm A ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> erased_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_CPi (Eq a b A) B) )
 | erased_a_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (b:tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> erased_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_UCAbs b) )
 | erased_a_CApp : forall (a:tm),
     erased_tm a ->
     erased_tm  ( (a_CApp a g_Triv) )
 | erased_a_Fam : forall (F:tyfam),
     erased_tm (a_Fam F)
 | erased_a_Const : forall (T:const),
     erased_tm (a_Const T).

(* defns JChk *)
Inductive RhoCheck : relflag -> tmvar -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn RhoCheck *)
 | Rho_Rel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      True  ->
     RhoCheck Rel x A
 | Rho_IrrRel : forall (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
      x  \notin fv_tm_tm_tm  A  ->
     RhoCheck Irrel x A.

(* defns Jpar *)
Inductive Par : context -> available_props -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Par *)
 | Par_Refl : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Par G D a a
 | Par_Beta : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a' b':tm),
     Par G D a  ( (a_UAbs rho a') )  ->
     Par G D b b' ->
     Par G D (a_App a rho b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a' b':tm),
     Par G D a a' ->
     Par G D b b' ->
     Par G D (a_App a rho b) (a_App a' rho b')
 | Par_CBeta : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a a':tm),
     Par G D a  ( (a_UCAbs a') )  ->
     Par G D (a_CApp a g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  a'   g_Triv )
 | Par_CApp : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a a':tm),
     Par G D a a' ->
     Par G D (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp a' g_Triv)
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (a a':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par G D  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par G D (a_UAbs rho a) (a_UAbs rho a')
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (A B A' B':tm),

      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par G D  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par G D (a_Pi rho A B) (a_Pi rho A' B')
 | Par_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (a a':tm),
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Par G D  ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     Par G D (a_UCAbs a) (a_UCAbs a')
 | Par_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (A B A1 a A' B' A1' a':tm),
     Par G D A A' ->
     Par G D B B' ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> Par G D  ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a' (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     Par G D A1 A1' ->
     Par G D (a_CPi (Eq A B A1) a) (a_CPi (Eq A' B' A1') a')
 | Par_Axiom : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
      binds  F  (Ax  a A )   toplevel   ->
     Par G D (a_Fam F) a
with MultiPar : context -> available_props -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn MultiPar *)
 | MP_Refl : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     MultiPar G D a a
 | MP_Step : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a a' b:tm),
     Par G D a b ->
     MultiPar G D b a' ->
     MultiPar G D a a'
with joins : context -> available_props -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn joins *)
 | join : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     MultiPar G D a1 b ->
     MultiPar G D a2 b ->
     joins G D a1 a2.

(* defns Jbeta *)
Inductive Beta : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn Beta *)
 | Beta_AppAbs : forall (rho:relflag) (v b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Value  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  ->
     Beta (a_App  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  rho b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  v   b )
 | Beta_CAppCAbs : forall (a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs a') ->
     Beta (a_CApp  ( (a_UCAbs a') )  g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  a'   g_Triv )
 | Beta_Axiom : forall (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
      binds  F  (Ax  a A )   toplevel   ->
     Beta (a_Fam F) a
with reduction_in_one : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn reduction_in_one *)
 | E_AbsTerm : forall (L:vars) (a a':tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> reduction_in_one  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a' (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     reduction_in_one (a_UAbs Irrel a) (a_UAbs Irrel a')
 | E_AppLeft : forall (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     reduction_in_one a a' ->
     reduction_in_one (a_App a rho b) (a_App a' rho b)
 | E_CAppLeft : forall (a a':tm),
     reduction_in_one a a' ->
     reduction_in_one (a_CApp a g_Triv) (a_CApp a' g_Triv)
 | E_AppAbs : forall (rho:relflag) (v a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  ->
     reduction_in_one (a_App  ( (a_UAbs rho v) )  rho a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  v   a )
 | E_CAppCAbs : forall (b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_UCAbs b) ->
     reduction_in_one (a_CApp  ( (a_UCAbs b) )  g_Triv)  (open_tm_wrt_co  b   g_Triv )
 | E_Axiom : forall (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
      binds  F  (Ax  a A )   toplevel   ->
     reduction_in_one (a_Fam F) a
with reduction : tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn reduction *)
 | Equal : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     reduction a a
 | Step : forall (a a' b:tm),
     reduction_in_one a b ->
     reduction b a' ->
     reduction a a'.

(* defns Jett *)
Inductive AnnPropWff : context -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnPropWff *)
 | An_Wff : forall (G:context) (a b A B:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnTyping G b B ->
      (  (erase_tm  A )   =   (erase_tm  B )  )  ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a b A)
with AnnTyping : context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnTyping *)
 | An_Star : forall (G:context),
     AnnCtx G ->
     AnnTyping G a_Star a_Star
 | An_Var : forall (G:context) (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->
      binds  x  (Tm  A )  G  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Var_f x) A
 | An_Pi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A B:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  a_Star )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G A a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A B) a_Star
 | An_Abs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A a B:tm),
      ( AnnTyping G A a_Star )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  (erase_tm   ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Abs rho A a) (a_Pi rho A B)
 | An_App : forall (G:context) (b:tm) (rho:relflag) (a B A:tm),
     AnnTyping G b (a_Pi rho A B) ->
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnTyping G (a_App b rho a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | An_Conv : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (g:co) (B A:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g A B ->
     AnnTyping G B a_Star ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Conv a g) B
 | An_CPi : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (phi:constraint) (B:tm),
      ( AnnPropWff G phi )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi B) a_Star
 | An_CAbs : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (phi:constraint) (a B:tm),
      ( AnnPropWff G phi )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnTyping  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B (g_Var_f c) )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CAbs phi a) (a_CPi phi B)
 | An_CApp : forall (G:context) (a1:tm) (g:co) (B a b A1:tm),
     AnnTyping G a1 (a_CPi (Eq a b A1) B) ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g a b ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CApp a1 g)  (open_tm_wrt_co  B   g )
 | An_Fam : forall (G:context) (F:tyfam) (A a:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->
      binds  F  (Ax  a A )   an_toplevel   ->
      ( AnnTyping  nil  A a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Fam F) A
with AnnIso : context -> available_props -> co -> constraint -> constraint -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnIso *)
 | An_PropCong : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1:co) (A:tm) (g2:co) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->
     AnnDefEq G D g2 B1 B2 ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq A1 B1 A) ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq A2 B2 A) ->
     AnnIso G D  ( (g_EqCong g1 A g2) )   ( (Eq A1 B1 A) )   ( (Eq A2 B2 A) )
 | An_CPiFst : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (phi1 phi2:constraint) (A2 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g (a_CPi phi1 A2) (a_CPi phi2 B2) ->
     AnnIso G D (g_CPiFst g) phi1 phi2
 | An_IsoSym : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (phi2 phi1:constraint),
     AnnIso G D g phi1 phi2 ->
     AnnIso G D (g_Sym g) phi2 phi1
 | An_IsoConv : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 A a1' a2' B:tm) (g:co),
     AnnDefEq G D g A B ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a1 a2 A) ->
     AnnPropWff G (Eq a1' a2' B) ->
      (  (erase_tm  a1 )   =   (erase_tm  a1' )  )  ->
      (  (erase_tm  a2 )   =   (erase_tm  a2' )  )  ->
     AnnIso G D (g_IsoConv  ( (Eq a1 a2 A) )   ( (Eq a1' a2' B) )  g)  ( (Eq a1 a2 A) )   ( (Eq a1' a2' B) )
with AnnDefEq : context -> available_props -> co -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnDefEq *)
 | An_Assn : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (c:covar) (a b A:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->
      binds  c  (Co  (Eq a b A) )  G  ->
      AtomSetImpl.In  c   D  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Var_f c) a b
 | An_Refl : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a A:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Refl a) a a
 | An_EraseEq : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a b:tm) (g:co) (A B:tm),
     AnnTyping G a A ->
     AnnTyping G b B ->
      (  (erase_tm  a )   =   (erase_tm  b )  )  ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g A B ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Refl2 a b g) a b
 | An_Sym : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (a b B A:tm) (g1:co),
     AnnTyping G b B ->
     AnnTyping G a A ->
      ( AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g1 B A )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D g b a ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Sym g) a b
 | An_Trans : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g2:co) (a b a1 A A1:tm) (g3:co),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 a a1 ->
     AnnDefEq G D g2 a1 b ->
      ( AnnTyping G a A )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G a1 A1 )  ->
      ( AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g3 A A1 )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D  ( (g_Trans g1 g2) )  a b
 | An_Beta : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (a1 a2 B0 B1:tm),
     AnnTyping G a1 B0 ->
     AnnTyping G a2 B1 ->
      (  (erase_tm  B0 )   =   (erase_tm  B1 )  )  ->
     Beta  (erase_tm  a1 )   (erase_tm  a2 )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Beta a1 a2) a1 a2
 | An_PiCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (g1 g2:co) (A1 B1 A2 B3 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( x ~ Tm  A1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_tm g2 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )    (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   (a_Var_f x) )   )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B3 (a_Var_f x) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   (a_Conv (a_Var_f x) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A1 B1) a_Star ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A1 B2) a_Star ->
     AnnTyping G (a_Pi rho A2 B3) a_Star ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_PiCong rho g1 g2)  ( (a_Pi rho A1 B1) )   ( (a_Pi rho A2 B3) )
 | An_AbsCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (rho:relflag) (g1 g2:co) (A1 b1 A2 b3 b2 B:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( x ~ Tm  A1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_tm g2 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )    (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Var_f x) )   )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b3 (a_Var_f x) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Conv (a_Var_f x) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G A1 a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G A2 a_Star ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  (erase_tm   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )  )  )  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> RhoCheck rho x  (erase_tm   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b3 (a_Var_f x) )  )  )  ->
      ( AnnTyping G  ( (a_Abs rho A1 b2) )  B )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D  ( (g_AbsCong rho g1 g2) )   ( (a_Abs rho A1 b1) )   ( (a_Abs rho A2 b3) )
 | An_AppCong : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1:co) (rho:relflag) (g2:co) (a1 a2 b1 b2 A B:tm) (g3:co),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 a1 b1 ->
     AnnDefEq G D g2 a2 b2 ->
     AnnTyping G (a_App a1 rho a2) A ->
     AnnTyping G (a_App b1 rho b2) B ->
      ( AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g3 A B )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_AppCong g1 rho g2) (a_App a1 rho a2) (a_App b1 rho b2)
 | An_PiFst : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (A1 A2:tm) (rho:relflag) (B1 B2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g (a_Pi rho A1 B1) (a_Pi rho A2 B2) ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_PiFst g) A1 A2
 | An_PiSnd : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g2:co) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (rho:relflag) (A1 A2:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 (a_Pi rho A1 B1) (a_Pi rho A2 B2) ->
     AnnDefEq G D g2 a1 a2 ->
     AnnTyping G a1 A1 ->
     AnnTyping G a2 A2 ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_PiSnd g1 g2)   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )     (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | An_CPiCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g3:co) (phi1:constraint) (B1:tm) (phi2:constraint) (B3 B2:tm),
     AnnIso G D g1 phi1 phi2 ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( c ~ Co  phi1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_co g3 (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co B1 (g_Var_f c) )    (open_tm_wrt_co  B2   (g_Var_f c) )   )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_co B3 (g_Var_f c) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_co  B2   (g_Cast (g_Var_f c) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi1 B1) a_Star ->
      ( AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi2 B3) a_Star )  ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CPi phi1 B2) a_Star ->
     AnnDefEq G D  ( (g_CPiCong g1 g3) )   ( (a_CPi phi1 B1) )   ( (a_CPi phi2 B3) )
 | An_CAbsCong : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g3 g4:co) (phi1:constraint) (a1:tm) (phi2:constraint) (a3 a2 B1 B B2:tm),
     AnnIso G D g1 phi1 phi2 ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  -> AnnDefEq  (( c ~ Co  phi1 ) ++  G )  D  ( open_co_wrt_co g3 (g_Var_f c) )   ( open_tm_wrt_co a1 (g_Var_f c) )    (open_tm_wrt_co  a2   (g_Var_f c) )   )  ->
      ( forall c , c \notin  L  ->  (  ( open_tm_wrt_co a3 (g_Var_f c) )   =   (open_tm_wrt_co  a2   (g_Cast (g_Var_f c) (g_Sym g1)) )  )  )  ->
     AnnTyping G  ( (a_CAbs phi1 a1) )  (a_CPi phi1 B1) ->
     AnnTyping G  ( (a_CAbs phi1 a2) )  B ->
     AnnTyping G  ( (a_CAbs phi2 a3) )  (a_CPi phi2 B2) ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g4 (a_CPi phi1 B1) (a_CPi phi2 B2) ->
     AnnDefEq G D  ( (g_CAbsCong g1 g3 g4) )   ( (a_CAbs phi1 a1) )   ( (a_CAbs phi2 a3) )
 | An_CAppCong : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g2 g3:co) (a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3 A B:tm) (g4:co),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 a1 b1 ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g2 a2 b2 ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g3 a3 b3 ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CApp a1 g2) A ->
     AnnTyping G (a_CApp b1 g3) B ->
      ( AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g4 A B )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_CAppCong g1 g2 g3) (a_CApp a1 g2) (a_CApp b1 g3)
 | An_CPiSnd : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g2 g3:co) (B1 B2 a a' A b b' B:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1  ( (a_CPi (Eq a a' A) B1) )   ( (a_CPi (Eq b b' B) B2) )  ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g2 a a' ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g3 b b' ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_CPiSnd g1 g2 g3)  (open_tm_wrt_co  B1   g2 )   (open_tm_wrt_co  B2   g3 )
 | An_Cast : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g1 g2:co) (b b' a a' A B:tm),
     AnnDefEq G D g1 a a' ->
     AnnIso G D g2 (Eq a a' A) (Eq b b' B) ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_Cast g1 g2) b b'
 | An_IsoSnd : forall (G:context) (D:available_props) (g:co) (A B a a' b b':tm),
     AnnIso G D g  ( (Eq a a' A) )   ( (Eq b b' B) )  ->
     AnnDefEq G D (g_IsoSnd g) A B
with AnnCtx : context -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnCtx *)
 | An_Empty :
     AnnCtx  nil
 | An_ConsTm : forall (G:context) (x:tmvar) (A:tm),
     AnnCtx G ->
     AnnTyping G A a_Star ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  G )  ->
     AnnCtx  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )
 | An_ConsCo : forall (G:context) (c:covar) (phi:constraint),
     AnnCtx G ->
     AnnPropWff G phi ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  c  (dom  G )  ->
     AnnCtx  (( c ~ Co  phi ) ++  G )
with AnnSig : sig -> Prop :=    (* defn AnnSig *)
 | An_Sig_Empty :
     AnnSig  nil
 | An_Sig_ConsAx : forall (S:sig) (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
     AnnSig S ->
     AnnTyping  nil  A a_Star ->
     AnnTyping  nil  a A ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  F  (dom  S )  ->
     AnnSig  (( F ~ Ax a A )++ S ) .

(* defns Jred *)
Inductive head_reduction : context -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=    (* defn head_reduction *)
 | An_AppLeft : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (rho:relflag) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     head_reduction G a a' ->
     head_reduction G (a_App a rho b) (a_App a' rho b)
 | An_AppAbs : forall (G:context) (rho:relflag) (A w a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value  ( (a_Abs rho A w) )  ->
     head_reduction G (a_App  ( (a_Abs rho A w) )  rho a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  w   a )
 | An_CAppLeft : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (g:co) (a':tm),
     lc_co g ->
     head_reduction G a a' ->
     head_reduction G (a_CApp a g) (a_CApp a' g)
 | An_CAppCAbs : forall (G:context) (phi:constraint) (b:tm) (g:co),
     lc_constraint phi ->
     lc_tm (a_CAbs phi b) ->
     lc_co g ->
     head_reduction G (a_CApp  ( (a_CAbs phi b) )  g)  (open_tm_wrt_co  b   g )
 | An_AbsTerm : forall (L:vars) (G:context) (A b b':tm),
     AnnTyping G A a_Star ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> head_reduction  (( x ~ Tm  A ) ++  G )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     head_reduction G  ( (a_Abs Irrel A b) )   ( (a_Abs Irrel A b') )
 | An_Axiom : forall (G:context) (F:tyfam) (a A:tm),
      binds  F  (Ax  a A )   an_toplevel   ->
     head_reduction G (a_Fam F) a
 | An_ConvTerm : forall (G:context) (a:tm) (g:co) (a':tm),
     lc_co g ->
     head_reduction G a a' ->
     head_reduction G (a_Conv a g) (a_Conv a' g)
 | An_Combine : forall (G:context) (v:tm) (g1 g2:co),
     lc_co g1 ->
     lc_co g2 ->
     Value v ->
     head_reduction G (a_Conv  ( (a_Conv v g1) )  g2) (a_Conv v  ( (g_Trans g1 g2) ) )
 | An_Push : forall (G:context) (v:tm) (g:co) (rho:relflag) (b b':tm) (g':co) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Value v ->
     AnnDefEq G  (dom  G )  g (a_Pi rho A1 B1) (a_Pi rho A2 B2) ->
      ( b'  =  (a_Conv b (g_Sym  ( (g_PiFst g) ) )) )  ->
      ( g'  =  (g_PiSnd g (g_Refl2 b' b  ( (g_PiFst g) ) )) )  ->
     head_reduction G (a_App  ( (a_Conv v g) )  rho b) (a_Conv  ( (a_App v rho b') )  g')
 | An_CPush : forall (G:context) (v:tm) (g g1 g1' g':co) (phi1:constraint) (A1:tm) (phi2:constraint) (A2:tm),

    q=re.search(r'(?:Fixpoint|with) open_'+cat+r'_wrt_'+kind+r'_rec ["'^'"\\n]*\\n  match ["'^'"\\n]*\\n(.*?)(?:\\nend|\\nwith)',src,re.S)
    body=q.group(1)
    return body
data={}
for cat in cats:
    t,c=(parsefun(cat,k) for k in ['tm','co'])
    pats=re.findall(r'"'^  '"\\| (.*?) =>',t,re.M)
    data[cat]=[]
    for pat in pats:
        st=t.split('  | '+pat+' =>',1)[1].split('\\n  | ',1)[0]
        sc=c.split('  | '+pat+' =>',1)[1].split('\\n  | ',1)[0]
        fields=[]
        for var in re.findall(r'\\w+',pat)[1:]:
            m=re.search(r'\\(open_(\\w+)_wrt_tm_rec (k|\\(S k\\)) a5 '+var+r'\\)',st)
            m2=re.search(r'\\(open_(\\w+)_wrt_co_rec (k|\\(S k\\)) g5 '+var+r'\\)',sc)
            if not m2 and cat=='co':
                m2=re.search(r'\\(open_(\\w+)_wrt_co_rec (k|\\(S k\\)) g_5 '+var+r'\\)',sc)
            if m:
                assert m2,(cat,pat,var,sc)

            else:
                fields.append((var,None,False,False))

        for pat,args in data[cat]:

        fs.append(f'{name}_{cat} {extra} (e : {cat}) {{struct e}} : {typ(cat)} :=\\n  match e with\\n'+ '\\n'.join(pats)+'\\n  end')
    return 'Fixpoint '+'\\nwith '.join(fs)+'.\\n'

def con(ctor,args,fn):
    return ' '.join([ctor]+[fn(v,c,t,k) if c else v for v,c,t,k in args])

Lemma scoped_open_tm :
  (forall e : tm, forall k (u : tm) nt nc, k <= nt -> scoped_tm nt nc u ->
   (scoped_tm nt nc (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u e) <-> scoped_tm (S nt) nc e)) /\
  (forall e : brs, forall k (u : tm) nt nc, k <= nt -> scoped_tm nt nc u ->
   (scoped_brs nt nc (open_brs_wrt_tm_rec k u e) <-> scoped_brs (S nt) nc e)) /\
  (forall e : co, forall k (u : tm) nt nc, k <= nt -> scoped_tm nt nc u ->
   (scoped_co nt nc (open_co_wrt_tm_rec k u e) <-> scoped_co (S nt) nc e)) /\
  (forall e : constraint, forall k (u : tm) nt nc, k <= nt -> scoped_tm nt nc u ->
   (scoped_constraint nt nc (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k u e) <-> scoped_constraint (S nt) nc e)).
Proof.
  apply syntax_ind; simpl; intros.
  all: try match goal with
  | |- context [lt_eq_lt_dec ?i ?k] =>
      destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec i k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl; try lia; tauto
  end.
  all: try reflexivity.
  all: repeat match goal with
  | IH : forall k u nt nc, _ -> _ -> _ <-> _, H : scoped_tm ?a ?b ?u |- _ =>
      first [rewrite (IH k u nt nc) by (first [lia | assumption])
            |rewrite (IH (S k) u (S nt) nc) by (first [lia | eapply scoped_mono_tm; [lia|lia|exact H]])
            |rewrite (IH k u (S nt) nc) by (first [lia | eapply scoped_mono_tm; [lia|lia|exact H]])
            |rewrite (IH (S k) u nt (S nc)) by (first [lia | eapply scoped_mono_tm; [lia|lia|exact H]])
            |rewrite (IH k u nt (S nc)) by (first [lia | eapply scoped_mono_tm; [lia|lia|exact H]])]
  end; reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint pure_tm a :=
  match a with
  | a_Star | a_Var_b _ | a_Var_f _ | a_Bullet | a_Fam _ | a_Const _ => True
  | a_UAbs _ b | a_UCAbs b => pure_tm b
  | a_App a _ b | a_Pi _ a b => pure_tm a /\\ pure_tm b
  | a_CPi p B => pure_constraint p /\\ pure_tm B
  | a_CApp a g => pure_tm a /\\ g = g_Triv
  | _ => False
  end
with pure_constraint p :=
  match p with Eq a b A => pure_tm a /\\ pure_tm b /\\ pure_tm A end.

Lemma erase_pure :
  (forall a, pure_tm (erase_tm a)) /\\ (forall b : brs, True) /\\
  (forall g : co, True) /\\ (forall p, pure_constraint (erase_constraint p)).
Proof. apply syntax_ind; simpl; intros; try destruct rho; simpl; tauto. Qed.
Definition erase_pure_tm := proj1 erase_pure.

Lemma pure_open_term :
  (forall a k u, pure_tm u -> (pure_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k u a) <-> pure_tm a)) /\\
  (forall b : brs, True) /\\ (forall g : co, True) /\\
  (forall p k u, pure_tm u -> (pure_constraint (open_constraint_wrt_tm_rec k u p) <-> pure_constraint p)).
Proof.
  apply syntax_ind; simpl; intros; try tauto.
  all: try solve [destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; simpl; tauto].
  all: try match goal with
  | |- (_ /\\ open_co_wrt_tm_rec _ _ ?g = g_Triv <-> _) =>
      destruct g; simpl; try (split; intros [? Hc]; discriminate); auto
  end.
  all: repeat match goal with
  | H : forall k u, pure_tm u -> _ <-> _ |- _ =>
    first [rewrite (H k u) by assumption | rewrite (H (S k) u) by assumption]
  end; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma pure_co_open :
  (forall a k g, pure_tm a -> open_tm_wrt_co_rec k g a = a) /\\
  (forall b : brs, True) /\\ (forall g : co, True) /\\
  (forall p k g, pure_constraint p -> open_constraint_wrt_co_rec k g p = p).
Proof.
  apply syntax_ind; simpl; intros; destruct_ands; subst; try contradiction; f_equal; auto.
Qed.
Definition pure_co_open_tm := proj1 pure_co_open.

Lemma pure_subst_tm :
  (forall a ft, (forall x, pure_tm (ft x)) -> pure_tm a -> pure_tm (subst_free_tm ft g_Var_f a)) /\\
  (forall b : brs, True) /\\ (forall g : co, True) /\\
  (forall p ft, (forall x, pure_tm (ft x)) -> pure_constraint p -> pure_constraint (subst_free_constraint ft g_Var_f p)).
Proof. apply syntax_ind; simpl; intros; destruct_ands; subst; simpl; tauto || auto. Qed.

Lemma pure_scoped_erased n : forall a, syntax_size_tm a < n ->
  scoped_tm 0 0 a -> pure_tm a -> erased_tm a.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros a Hn Hs Hp; [lia|].
  destruct a; simpl in Hn, Hs, Hp; try contradiction; try lia.
  all: destruct_ands.
  all: try solve [constructor; eauto].
  - eapply erased_a_Abs with (L := {}).
    intros x _. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm.
    apply IH; [rewrite size_open_tm_tm; lia | apply scoped_open_tm_tm; [lia|exact I|assumption]
              |apply (proj1 pure_open_term); auto].
  - constructor; apply IH; auto; lia.
  - eapply erased_a_Pi with (L := {}); [apply IH; auto; lia|].
    intros x _. unfold open_tm_wrt_tm.
    apply IH; [rewrite size_open_tm_tm; lia | apply scoped_open_tm_tm; [lia|exact I|assumption]
              |apply (proj1 pure_open_term); auto].
  - destruct c. simpl in *. destruct_ands.
    eapply erased_a_CPi with (L := {}); try solve [apply IH; auto; lia].
    intros x _. unfold open_tm_wrt_co.
    apply IH; [rewrite size_open_co_tm; lia | apply scoped_open_co_tm; [lia|exact I|assumption]
              |now rewrite pure_co_open_tm].
  - eapply erased_a_CAbs with (L := {}).
    intros x _. unfold open_tm_wrt_co.
    apply IH; [rewrite size_open_co_tm; lia | apply scoped_open_co_tm; [lia|exact I|assumption]
              |now rewrite pure_co_open_tm].
  - subst. apply erased_a_CApp. apply IH; auto; lia.
Qed.

Lemma erased_of_scoped a : scoped_tm 0 0 a -> erased_tm (erase_tm a).
Proof.
  intro H.
  eapply pure_scoped_erased with (n := S (syntax_size_tm (erase_tm a)));
    [lia|now apply scoped_erase_tm|apply erase_pure_tm].
Qed.

Definition PR := Par nil {}.
Definition MP := MultiPar nil {}.

Lemma par_change_context G D a b :
  Par G D a b -> forall E D', Par E D' a b.
Proof. induction 1; intros; eauto using Par. Qed.
Lemma mp_change_context G D a b :
  MultiPar G D a b -> forall E D', MultiPar E D' a b.
Proof. induction 1; intros; eauto using MultiPar, par_change_context. Qed.

Lemma par_scoped G D a b :
  Par G D a b -> scoped_tm 0 0 a /\\ scoped_tm 0 0 b.
Proof.
  induction 1; try solve [split; apply (proj1 lc_scoped); assumption].
  all: use_fresh_open; simpl in *; destruct_ands; repeat split; try assumption.
  all: try solve [discharge_scoped_open].
  apply fix_erased_binding in H as [-> [-> ->]]. simpl; repeat split; lia.
Qed.

Lemma par_pure G D a b :
  Par G D a b -> pure_tm a -> pure_tm b.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl in *; intros Hp; try assumption.
  all: destruct_ands; repeat split; auto.
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_tm. apply (proj1 pure_open_term); auto.
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_co. rewrite pure_co_open_tm; auto.
  - use_fresh_open. apply (proj1 pure_open_term _ 0 (a_Var_f (proj1_sig (atom_fresh L))) I).
    apply H0. apply (proj1 pure_open_term); auto.
  - use_fresh_open. apply (proj1 pure_open_term _ 0 (a_Var_f (proj1_sig (atom_fresh L))) I).
    apply H1. apply (proj1 pure_open_term); auto.
  - use_fresh_open. unfold open_tm_wrt_co in *. rewrite pure_co_open_tm in *; auto.
  - use_fresh_open. unfold open_tm_wrt_co in *. rewrite pure_co_open_tm in *; auto.
  - apply fix_erased_binding in H as [-> [-> ->]]. apply erase_pure_tm.
Qed.

Lemma head_subst G a b :
  head_reduction G a b -> forall E W ft fc, typed_subst G E W ft fc ->
  head_reduction E (subst_free_tm ft fc a) (subst_free_tm ft fc b).

    cbn [subst_free_tm subst_free_co subst_free_constraint].

    + eauto using lc_subst_constraint.
    + exact (lc_subst_tm _ _ _ _ Hm H0).

  - assert (AT : AnnTyping E (subst_free_tm ft fc A) a_Star)
      by (exact (proj1 ann_subst _ _ _ H _ _ _ E (conj Hm (conj HE HM)))).
    apply An_AbsTerm with (L := L \\u W \\u dom E); [exact AT|].
    intros x Hx.
    assert (HE' : AnnCtx (x ~ Tm (subst_free_tm ft fc A) ++ E))
      by (apply An_ConsTm; [exact HE | exact AT | fsetdec]).
    assert (HM' : CtxMap (x ~ Tm A ++ G) (x ~ Tm (subst_free_tm ft fc A) ++ E) ft fc)
      by (apply extend_tm_ctx_map; [exact HE' | exact HM | eapply map_term_id; [exact Hm|fsetdec]]).
    pose proof (H1 x ltac:(fsetdec) _ _ _ _ (conj Hm (conj HE' HM'))) as HH.
    subst_open_fresh x; exact HH.

    eapply An_Axiom with (A := FixTy). unfold an_toplevel; simpl; auto.
  - apply An_ConvTerm; [eauto using lc_subst_co | eauto 6].

  - intros z b c B HB Hz; eapply ctx_map_co; [exact HM | |].
    + destruct HB as [HB|HB]; simpl; auto.

#[local] Hint Constructors Par MultiPar : par.

Lemma par_refl_scoped G D a : scoped_tm 0 0 a -> Par G D a a.
Proof. constructor; now apply scoped_lc_tm. Qed.
Lemma par_refl_left G D a b : Par G D a b -> Par G D a a.
Proof. intro H; apply par_refl_scoped; exact (proj1 (par_scoped _ _ _ _ H)). Qed.
Lemma par_refl_right G D a b : Par G D a b -> Par G D b b.
Proof. intro H; apply par_refl_scoped; exact (proj2 (par_scoped _ _ _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma par_uabs_inv G D r a b :
  Par G D (a_UAbs r a) b ->
  exists b0 L, b = a_UAbs r b0 /\\
    forall x, x \\notin L ->
      Par G D (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm b0 (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst; eauto 8.
  exists a, {}. split; [reflexivity|]. intros x _.
  apply par_refl_scoped.
  pose proof (proj1 (par_scoped _ _ _ _ H)) as HC. simpl in HC.
  discharge_scoped_open.
Qed.

Lemma par_ucabs_inv G D a b :
  pure_tm a -> Par G D (a_UCAbs a) b ->
  exists b0, b = a_UCAbs b0 /\\ Par G D a b0.
Proof.
  intros Hp H. inversion H; subst.
  - exists a. split; [reflexivity|].
    pose proof (proj1 (par_scoped _ _ _ _ H)) as HC. simpl in HC.
    replace a with (open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f Fix)) by (symmetry; now apply pure_tm_open_co).
    apply par_refl_scoped. discharge_scoped_open.
  - exists a'. split; [reflexivity|].
    use_fresh_open.
    assert (Hp' : pure_tm a') by (eapply par_pure; [exact H | exact Hp]).
    now rewrite "'!pure_tm_open_co in H0 by assumption.
Qed.

Lemma par_rename G D x y a b :
  Par G D a b -> pure_tm a ->
  Par G D (subst_free_tm (replace_term x (a_Var_f y)) g_Var_f a)
          (subst_free_tm (replace_term x (a_Var_f y)) g_Var_f b).
Proof.
  intros H Hp. eapply par_subst; last exact Hp; try exact H;
    try solve [apply replace_term_maps; exact I].
  intro z. destruct (atom_eq_dec x z) as [->|Hneq].
  - rewrite replace_term_eq. constructor; constructor.
  - rewrite replace_term_neq by assumption. constructor; constructor.
Qed.

Lemma par_binder_join G D L a b :
  pure_tm a -> pure_tm b ->
  (forall x, x '"\\notin L -> exists w,
   Par G D (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) w /\\
   Par G D (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) w) ->
  exists w, forall x, x \\notin L ->
   Par G D (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm w (a_Var_f x)) /\\
   Par G D (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm w (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros Ha Hb Hjoin. take_fresh (L \\u support_tm a \\u support_tm b) x HF.
  destruct (Hjoin x ltac:(fsetdec)) as [w [H1 H2]].
  exists (close_term_tm 0 x w). intros y Hy.
  change (open_tm_wrt_tm _ _) with (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 (a_Var_f y) (close_term_tm 0 x w)).
  rewrite (proj1 open_close_rename).
  split.
  - pose proof (par_rename _ _ x y _ _ H1 (proj2 (pure_tm_open_var a x) Ha)) as H.
    now rewrite binder_rename in H by fsetdec.
  - pose proof (par_rename _ _ x y _ _ H2 (proj2 (pure_tm_open_var b x) Hb)) as H.
    now rewrite binder_rename in H by fsetdec.
Qed.

Ltac par_subjoin :=
  match goal with
  | IH : forall c, Par ?G ?D ?a c -> _ -> exists w, Par ?G ?D ?b w /\\ Par ?G ?D c w,
    H : Par ?G ?D ?a ?c, Hp : pure_tm ?a |- _ =>
      tryif constr_eq b c then fail else
      let w := fresh \"w\" in let H1 := fresh in let H2 := fresh in
      destruct (IH c H Hp) as [w [H1 H2]]; clear IH
  end.

Ltac par_abs_inv :=
  match goal with H : Par _ _ (a_UAbs _ _) _ |- _ =>
    let w := fresh \"w\" in let L := fresh \"L\" in let HB := fresh in
    let E := fresh in destruct (par_uabs_inv _ _ _ _ _ H) as [w [L [E HB]]];
    try subst
  end.

Lemma par_diamond G D a b c :
  Par G D a b -> Par G D a c -> pure_tm a ->
  exists w, Par G D b w /\\ Par G D c w.
Proof.
  intro H. revert c.
  induction H; intros c Hc Hp; try solve [exists c; split; auto using par_refl_right].
  all: inversion Hc; subst; try solve [eexists; split; [eapply par_refl_right|]; eauto with par].
  all: simpl in Hp; destruct_ands.
  all: repeat par_subjoin.
  all: try match goal with
  | |- exists w, Par _ _ (a_App _ ?r _) w /\\ Par _ _ (a_App _ ?r _) w =>
    eexists; split; apply Par_App; eassumption
  | |- exists w, Par _ _ (a_CApp _ g_Triv) w /\\ Par _ _ (a_CApp _ g_Triv) w =>
    eexists; split; apply Par_CApp; eassumption
  end.
  all: try match goal with
  | |- exists w, Par _ _ (open_tm_wrt_tm _ _) w /\\ _ => idtac
  | |- exists w, _ /\\ Par _ _ (open_tm_wrt_tm _ _) w => idtac
  end.

Lemma mp_scoped a b : MP a b -> scoped_tm 0 0 a /\\ scoped_tm 0 0 b.

Lemma mp_pure a b : MP a b -> pure_tm a -> pure_tm b.

Lemma mp_single a b : PR a b -> MP a b.

Lemma mp_trans a b c : MP a b -> MP b c -> MP a c.

Lemma mp_strip a b c : PR a b -> MP a c -> pure_tm a ->

Lemma mp_confluent a b c : MP a b -> MP a c -> pure_tm a -> joinable b c.

Lemma join_sym a b : joinable a b -> joinable b a.

Lemma join_trans a b c : joinable a b -> joinable b c -> pure_tm b -> joinable a c.

Lemma erase_binding G x s :
  binds x s G -> binds x (erase_sort s) (erase_context G).
Proof. intro H. unfold erase_context. now apply binds_map. Qed.

Lemma valid_erase_sort s : scoped_sort s -> erased_sort (erase_sort s).
Proof.
  destruct s as [A|[a b A]]; simpl; intros H; destruct_ands;
    constructor; now apply erased_of_scoped.
Qed.

Lemma ann_good_extend G D x s :
  AnnGood G D -> scoped_sort s ->
  (forall p, s = Co p -> x \\notin D) ->
  AnnGood (x ~ s ++ G) D.
Proof.
  intros [HE HG] Hs Hx. split.
  - simpl. constructor; [now apply valid_erase_sort|exact HE].
  - intros y a b A Hb Hy. destruct Hb as [Heq|Hb].
    + destruct s; inversion Heq; subst; exfalso; eapply Hx; [reflexivity|exact Hy].
    + destruct (HG _ _ _ _ Hb Hy) as [u [H1 H2]].
      exists u; split; eapply par_change_context; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ann_good_tm_extend G D x A :
  AnnGood G D -> scoped_tm 0 0 A -> AnnGood (x ~ Tm A ++ G) D.
Proof. intros. apply ann_good_extend; auto; discriminate. Qed.
Lemma ann_good_co_extend G D x p :
  AnnGood G D -> scoped_constraint 0 0 p -> x \\notin D ->
  AnnGood (x ~ Co p ++ G) D.
Proof. intros. apply ann_good_extend; auto. Qed.

Lemma erase_join_refl a :
  scoped_tm 0 0 a -> joinable (erase_tm a) (erase_tm a).
Proof. intro H; apply join_refl; now apply scoped_erase_tm. Qed.

Lemma typing_join_refl G a A :
  AnnTyping G a A -> joinable (erase_tm a) (erase_tm a).
Proof. intro H; apply erase_join_refl; exact (proj1 (typing_scoped _ _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma beta_par a b : Beta a b -> scoped_tm 0 0 a -> PR a b.
Proof.
  destruct 1; intro HS; simpl in HS; destruct_ands.
  - eapply Par_Beta; apply par_refl_scoped; simpl; assumption.
  - eapply Par_CBeta; apply par_refl_scoped; simpl; assumption.
  - now eapply Par_Axiom.
Qed.

Lemma par_join a b : PR a b -> joinable a b.
Proof.
  intro H. exists b. split; [now apply mp_single |].
  apply mp_refl. exact (proj2 (par_scoped _ _ _ _ H)).
Qed.

Lemma erase_cast_body L a b g :
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) =
    open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Conv (a_Var_f x) g)) ->
  erase_tm a = erase_tm b.
Proof.
  intro H. take_fresh (L \\u support_tm (erase_tm a) \\u support_tm (erase_tm b)) x Hx.
  apply (opening_injective_tm x); try fsetdec.
  pose proof (f_equal erase_tm (H x ltac:(fsetdec))) as HE.
  unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in *. now rewrite "'!erase_open_tm_tm in HE.
Qed.

Lemma erase_co_cast_body L a b g :
  (forall x, x '"\\notin L -> open_tm_wrt_co a (g_Var_f x) =
    open_tm_wrt_co b (g_Cast (g_Var_f x) g)) ->
  erase_tm a = erase_tm b.
Proof.
  intro H. take_fresh L x Hx.
  pose proof (f_equal erase_tm (H x Hx)) as HE.
  unfold open_tm_wrt_co in HE. now rewrite "'!erase_open_co_tm in HE.
Qed.

Lemma cofinite_erase_tm_join L a b :
  (forall x, x '"\\notin L ->
    joinable (erase_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x)))
             (erase_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)))) ->
  forall x, x \\notin L ->
    joinable (open_tm_wrt_tm (erase_tm a) (a_Var_f x))
             (open_tm_wrt_tm (erase_tm b) (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros H x Hx. specialize (H x Hx).
  unfold open_tm_wrt_tm in *. now rewrite "'!erase_open_tm_tm in H.
Qed.

Ltac erased_binder_body_join :=
  apply cofinite_erase_tm_join; intros x Hx;
  match goal with
  | IH : forall x, x '"\\notin ?L -> AnnGood _ _ -> _,
    Ht : AnnTyping ?G ?A a_Star |- _ =>
      apply IH; [exact Hx | apply ann_good_tm_extend; [assumption|exact (proj1 (typing_scoped _ _ _ Ht))]]
  end.

Ltac erased_co_body_join :=
  match goal with
  | IH : forall x, x \\notin ?L -> AnnGood _ ?D -> _,
    H : AnnGood ?G ?D, P : AnnPropWff ?G ?p |- _ =>

      unfold open_tm_wrt_co in HJ; rewrite "'!erase_open_co_tm in HJ; exact HJ
  end.

Lemma ann_sound :
  (forall G a A, AnnTyping G a A -> True) /'"\\
  (forall G p, AnnPropWff G p -> True) /\\
  (forall G D g p q, AnnIso G D g p q -> AnnGood G D ->
    prop_join (erase_constraint p) (erase_constraint q)) /\\
  (forall G D g a b, AnnDefEq G D g a b -> AnnGood G D ->
    joinable (erase_tm a) (erase_tm b)) /\\
  (forall G, AnnCtx G -> True).
Proof.
  apply ann_ind; intros; try exact I.
  - simpl. repeat split; auto.
    apply erase_join_refl. match goal with H : AnnPropWff _ (Eq _ _ A) |- _ =>
      pose proof (prop_scoped _ _ H); simpl in *; tauto end.
  - destruct phi1, phi2; simpl in *.
    apply join_cpi_fst with (B := erase_tm A2) (B' := erase_tm B2); auto.
  - destruct phi1, phi2; simpl in *; specialize (H H0); destruct_ands; repeat split; now apply join_sym.
  - simpl. repeat split; auto.
    + rewrite <- e. eapply typing_join_refl. inversion a0; eassumption.
    + rewrite <- e0. eapply typing_join_refl. inversion a0; eassumption.
  - destruct H0 as [_ HG].
    destruct (HG _ _ _ _ (erase_binding _ _ _ b0) i) as [u [H1 H2]].
    exists u; split; apply mp_single; eapply par_change_context; eassumption.
  - eapply typing_join_refl; eassumption.
  - rewrite <- e. eapply typing_join_refl; eassumption.
  - apply join_sym; auto.
  - eapply join_trans; [apply H|apply H0|apply erase_pure_tm]; assumption.
  - apply par_join, beta_par; [assumption|].
    apply scoped_erase_tm. exact (proj1 (typing_scoped _ _ _ a)).
  - simpl. rewrite (erase_cast_body L B3 B2 (g_Sym g1) e).
    eapply join_pi_lift with (L := L); try solve [apply erase_pure_tm | auto].
    inversion a1; subst. erased_binder_body_join.
  - simpl. rewrite (erase_cast_body L b3 b2 (g_Sym g1) e).
    eapply join_abs_lift with (L := L); [erased_binder_body_join|apply erase_pure_tm|apply erase_pure_tm].
  - destruct rho; simpl; apply join_app; try solve [apply erase_pure_tm | exact I | auto].
    apply join_refl; exact I.
  - eapply join_pi_fst; apply H; assumption.
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_tm at 1 2. rewrite "'!erase_open_tm_tm.
    change (joinable (open_tm_wrt_tm (erase_tm B1) (erase_tm a1))
                     (open_tm_wrt_tm (erase_tm B2) (erase_tm a2))).
    eapply join_pi_snd with (r := rho) (A := erase_tm A1) (A'"' := erase_tm A2);
      try solve [apply erase_pure_tm | auto].
  - assert (HB : joinable (erase_tm B1) (erase_tm B2)).
    { inversion a; subst. erased_co_body_join. }
    rewrite (erase_co_cast_body L B3 B2 (g_Sym g1) e).
    destruct phi1, phi2; simpl in *.
    specialize (H H5). destruct_ands.
    eapply join_cpi_lift; try solve [apply erase_pure_tm | assumption].
  - assert (HB : joinable (erase_tm a1) (erase_tm a2)).
    { inversion a; subst. erased_co_body_join. }
    simpl. rewrite (erase_co_cast_body L a3 a2 (g_Sym g1) e).
    now apply join_ucabs_lift; try apply erase_pure_tm.
  - simpl. now apply join_capp; try apply erase_pure_tm; auto.
  - unfold open_tm_wrt_co. rewrite "'!erase_open_co_tm.
    eapply join_cpi_snd with (a := erase_tm a) (b := erase_tm a'"') (A := erase_tm A)
      (a' := erase_tm b) (b' := erase_tm b') (A' := erase_tm B);
      try apply erase_pure_tm; auto.
  - simpl in H0. specialize (H0 ltac:(assumption)); destruct H0 as [M1 [M2 _]].
    eapply join_trans; [now apply join_sym, M1 | |apply erase_pure_tm].
    eapply join_trans; [apply H; assumption | exact M2 | apply erase_pure_tm].
  - simpl in H. specialize (H ltac:(assumption)); tauto.
Qed.
Definition ann_eq_sound := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 ann_sound))).
